intent: Individually authored context, meaning, timetable and picture tasks. All schedules are original practice records. No independent mastery or audio credit.

workshop.title: 读新安排，选对场地，再算活动时长
workshop.instruction: 先看词在这句话里做什么，再补词并写自己的例子。最后读更新通知，分清社团和考试的日期、地点与时间。

items.label: test：测试模型，不一定是考试
items.prompt: 记录：We will test the model outdoors tomorrow. 这里test要求做什么？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：We will test the model outdoors tomorrow. 这里test要求做什么？

items.material: We will test the model outdoors tomorrow.
items.reason: test可作名词“测试”，也可作动词“检验”。will后接原形test；昨天的动作可用tested，进行形式是testing。不能把每次test都理解成坐在教室考试。
items.hint: test a model：检验模型；take a test：参加测试。

options.text: Try the model to see how well it works.
options.reason: test the model表示检验模型的性能。

options.text: Sit a written school exam about the model.
options.reason: 这句的宾语是model，没有要求参加笔试。

options.text: Report that the model was tested yesterday.
options.reason: will和tomorrow说的是明天的计划，不是昨天已经完成的检验。

items.label: exam：先核对考场，不把两场活动混在一起
items.prompt: 原创通知：The exam is in Room 302. The club meeting is in Room 204. Where should you go for the exam?

wordDecision.prompt: 原创通知：The exam is in Room 302. The club meeting is in Room 204. Where should you go for the exam?

items.material: Check the room number before the exam.
items.before: Check the room number before the
items.reason: exam是examination的常用简写，exams是复数。考试形式可能不同，本题只要求根据这条原创通知找考场，不能凭另一次活动的教室猜。
items.hint: the exam → Room 302；the club meeting → Room 204。

options.text: Room 204.
options.reason: 204是社团活动室，不是本条通知的考场。

options.text: Room 302.
options.reason: 通知把exam和Room 302配在一起。

options.text: Either room; the numbers mean the same thing.
options.reason: 两间教室的号码不同，对应的活动也不同。

items.label: grade：年级和成绩等级，搭配告诉你
items.prompt: 记录：The report gives this project a grade of A. 这里grade表示什么？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：The report gives this project a grade of A. 这里grade表示什么？

items.material: My brother is in the grade below mine.
items.reason: in the grade below mine中grade是年级；a grade of A中grade是成绩等级。grade还可作动词“评定等级、评分”：graded、grading。看各自搭配，不把同一个词固定成一种意思。
items.hint: school grade：年级；a grade of A：成绩等级。

options.text: A level awarded for the quality of the project.
options.reason: a grade of A是项目得到的成绩等级。

options.text: A year group in a school.
options.reason: 项目不是在某个年级上学的人；这里说的是评价结果。

options.text: The number of minutes spent on the project.
options.reason: grade of A没有给出用时。

items.label: term：学期之外，还可能是术语
items.prompt: 记录：In this report, evaporation is a scientific term. 这里term表示什么？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：In this report, evaporation is a scientific term. 这里term表示什么？

items.material: We are building a weather station this term.
items.before: We are building a weather station this
items.reason: this term通常表示这学期；a scientific term表示一个科学术语。terms可表示多个学期或多个术语，要由上下文判断；不能把term一律换成“学期”。
items.hint: this term：这学期；scientific term：科学术语。

options.text: A part of the school year with lessons.
options.reason: this term可指这学期，但这条新记录在解释科学用词。

options.text: A word or expression used in science.
options.reason: scientific term指科学领域的术语。

options.text: The temperature measured by the weather station.
options.reason: term不是温度读数，记录也没有给出温度值。

items.label: timetable：开始时间和结束时间别看反
items.prompt: 新时间表：Chess 16:00–16:35; Science 16:45–17:15. When does the chess activity finish?

wordDecision.prompt: 新时间表：Chess 16:00–16:35; Science 16:45–17:15. When does the chess activity finish?

items.material: The new timetable leaves time for reading.
items.reason: timetable可指课程表、活动时间表或交通时刻表，timetables是复数。读起止时间先对准活动名称，再分清开始和结束；不能拿下一项的时间回答。

options.reason: 16:00是Chess的开始时间，不是结束时间。
16:45是下一项Science的开始时间。
Chess一行的后一个时间16:35是结束时间。

transfer.stem: Which plan follows this updated activity notice?
transfer.passage:
FRIDAY UPDATE
This term, our Grade Eight chess club is helping with the school activity day. The old timetable put our club meeting on Thursday at 15:40. The meeting is now on Friday, from 16:00 to 16:35, in Room 204. Do not go to the playground: it is wet after the rain. Wear the school uniform for the club photograph. The separate written exam is on Monday at 09:00 in Room 302. Bring a pen for that exam. These are original practice arrangements, not a real school notice.

options.text: Meet on Thursday at 15:40 because that was in the old timetable.
Meet on the playground on Friday at 16:00.
Meet in Room 204 on Friday at 16:00; the meeting lasts thirty-five minutes.
Go to Room 204 for the written exam on Monday.

answer.display: Meet in Room 204 on Friday at 16:00; the meeting lasts thirty-five minutes.

explanation.strategy: 先追到更新后的日期和地点，再用同一项活动的起止时间算时长。

steps.text: 按新通知，周五16:00到204教室参加社团活动。
steps.reason: now把Thursday at 15:40更新为Friday at 16:00；in Room 204给出新地点，wet playground明确排除了操场。
16:35减去16:00等于35分钟。Monday的09:00和302教室属于另一场笔试，不能混用。

distractors.reason: 照搬old timetable，忽略了now引出的更新。
日期和时间对了，但通知明确说操场雨后湿滑，不去操场。
把社团活动的204教室用于另一场考试；考试在302教室。

explanation.pitfall: 旧安排、新安排和另一场考试分开读；时长必须取同一项活动的起止时间。
